{{Top|leg}}
'''Cryogenic cylinders''' were cooling technology components used in [[Loronar Defense Industries]]' [[MAS-2xB]]. The [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long units were installed in four [[cooling chamber]]s that were wrapped around the weapon's [[Power core/Legends|power core]], [[EMS-500|energy capacitors]], and the [[turbolaser pulsor]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
